decisions.reason: The CCTA 06H121026ED module is a plausible repair-role match and both destinations are exact product pages, but its 2009-2017/2018 Limited scope exists only in prose. The stored part has no enforceable fitment or variant scope, so it can be shown to redesigned 2018-2021 DGUA vehicles where it is not the stated part.

The DGUA thermostat/housing 06L121111P is a plausible exact product, but its redesigned 2018-2021 scope is recorded only in the note. With no enforceable fitment or variant scope, the public card can show it to 2009-2017 CCTA vehicles, so the otherwise useful eBay plus OEM-retailer pair must remain blocked until scoped.

The DGUA mechanical pump 06L121012L is distinct from the thermostat housing and appears to have exact eBay and OEM-retailer links, but the required redesigned 2018-2021 DGUA scope is not encoded in fitment. It can therefore be exposed to the earlier CCTA application and must be held until variant gating is enforceable.

G12Evo coolant is a service fluid rather than proof of which failed component repairs this mixed-generation issue, and the existing card has no enforceable application or quantity scope. It should be handled by service-fluid guidance, not presented as an unscoped verified repair part for every Tiguan year in the article.
